name: Document Ingestion Workflow
description: Turn uploaded task-book documents into normalized text and structured task requirements before handing off to the lab-report agent workflow.
userConfirmSteps: select task-book file when multiple files exist
qualityRules: Do not execute uploaded document macros or scripts.
Do not fake stdout, stderr, screenshots, or runtime results.
Do not parse datasets, screenshots, or source code as task books by default.
Unsupported file types must return clear Chinese messages.
AI structure failures should produce warnings and deterministic fallback, not a hard 502 when usable text exists.
Service-role keys and Moonshot keys must stay server-side only.
